title: Life Plan Benefits Bulletin: Care Fee Discount on Respite Medication Setup
content:
Life Plan households holding a Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement carry their plan's care fee discount into the medication setup charge of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

**Benefit.** The Life Plan care discount on medication setup is the care fee discount of the guest's plan, taken as a percentage, for a guest holding an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare plan or on a fee-for-service plan, and nothing otherwise.

**What it reduces.** The discount is taken on the packaging charge as it stands, and on nothing else in the medication setup charge: the packaging charge is multiplied by the part the discount leaves.

**Records read.** The guest's Entrance Fee Agreement, whether it is in occupied status, the contract type of its plan and that plan's care fee discount.

| Entrance Fee Agreement | Contract type | Care fee discount | Part of the packaging charge left |
|---|---|---|---|
| Occupied, LifeCare Declining Balance Plan or LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | Lifecare | 100 percent | None |
| Occupied, LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% or 90% Refundable Plan | Fee-for-service | 10 percent | 90 percent |
| Not occupied, or none held | — | Nothing (0 percent) | All of it |

## Hypothetical illustrations (packaging charge 85.00)

- Occupied LifeChoice agreement: 85.00 times 90 percent, that is 76.50.
- Occupied LifeCare agreement: 85.00 reduced by 100 percent, that is nothing.
- Agreement terminated before the stay: 85.00, no discount.
